describe.summary: Post to X as the owner's connected account, under the owner's policy, with the owner's confirmation where they asked for it; it reads only the account's own handle.

status.doc: Whether the credential works — proved by refreshing it — the OAuth client the run used, the policy with every member it holds, and the caller's own posts today.

me.doc: The connected account's handle, id and display name, for the UI.

post.doc: One post, policy-checked, then published — or, when the owner's policy lists `post` under `confirm`, left as a task for the owner and answered `awaiting_owner`. The answer carries the tweet id and its url.

confirm.doc: Carried out by a run of the agent that prepared the task, started by the platform on the owner's signed approval and paid by the agent's key: posts the text the task holds, under the policy the task was made under. The owner's note, when they wrote one, goes to the agent with the result.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval; opened by the host and handed to the agent with the result.

task_status.doc: Where a task this caller made stands: `open`, `approved`, `answering`, `done` with the result, `failed` with `failure_reason`, `rejected` with the owner's reason, `cancelled`, `expired`, `void`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task's id, as `post` answered it.

task_cancel.doc: Withdraw an open task this caller made.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task's id, as `post` answered it.

task_delete.doc: Delete a task this caller made that nothing was carried out on. One the owner's yes acted on, or may have, is refused task_closed.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task's id, as `post` answered it.

tasks.doc: The tasks this caller made for this owner: the open ones and the outcomes kept.

tasks_unlock.doc: The owner's own call: opens the waiting tasks for a device that was not signed in when they were made.
